title: What I lost to become a dermatologist — My Journey #dermatologist #skin #doctor #doctorlife
description:
✨ From Books to Beauty: My Journey to Becoming a Dermatologist ✨

It took me 28 years to become a doctor. While the world was busy celebrating, I was buried in books. Yes, I missed out on a lot, but I gained something priceless — knowledge, self-love, and the power to heal skin, hair, and confidence.

Hi, I’m Dr. Swasti Jain, MD Dermatologist. 🌸
This video is not just about skincare, it’s about learning to love yourself, glow naturally, and embrace life with confidence.

💎 What you’ll find here:

Honest experiences from my journey as a dermatologist

Tips for healthy, glowing skin

Secrets to shiny, lively hair

A dose of self-love & positivity

Fun + drama (because doctors aren’t boring 😉)


👉 If you’re looking for correct skincare guidance, entertainment, and an extra sparkle in your life, hit that FOLLOW and join me to Glow & Grow Together! ✨
